title: 561. Diagonal Traverse

examples.explanation: Diagonals are visited as [1], [2,4], [7,5,3], [6,8], [9] with alternating directions.
The two middle cells form one diagonal visited bottom-up after the start.

hints: Simulate position plus a direction flag instead of precomputing diagonals.
Hitting the right or top border while moving up-right means stepping right or down and flipping to down-left (mirror for the other direction).
Single-row and single-column grids are just linear walks; the same border rules handle them.
